title: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Ages
shortDescription: A compact Zelda adventure that makes changing eras part of its puzzle language and turns a small world into a layered set of routes.
highlights: Time-shifting puzzles make familiar spaces behave in two distinct states
A focused dungeon structure rewards observation and item mastery

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A Game Boy Color adventure pick that foregrounds the platform’s compact, puzzle-dense format while remaining clearly distinct from its companion game.
